arguments.command:
python -c "
from glom import Check, T

# Test basic Check repr
c = Check()
print('Check():', repr(c))

# Check with spec
c2 = Check(T['foo'])
print('Check(T[\"foo\"]):', repr(c2))

# Check with type
c3 = Check(type=int)
print('Check(type=int):', repr(c3))

# Check with one_of
c4 = Check(one_of=[1, 2, 3])
print('Check(one_of=[1,2,3]):', repr(c4))

# Check with equal_to
c5 = Check(equal_to='hello')
print('Check(equal_to=\"hello\"):', repr(c5))

# Check with instance_of
c6 = Check(instance_of=str)
print('Check(instance_of=str):', repr(c6))

# Check with validate
c7 = Check(validate=lambda x: x > 0)
print('Check(validate=lambda...):', repr(c7))

# Check with default
c8 = Check(default=None)
print('Check(default=None):', repr(c8))

# Complex check
c9 = Check(T['data'], type=(int, float), one_of=[1, 2, 3], default=0)
print('Complex check:', repr(c9))
"
